profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Engineer in Flighting and Installation Technologies (FIT) Fundamentals team. Worked on various projects to enable OEMs, IBVs and IHVs to manufacture Windows 10X devices. Currently working on next-gen Desktop manufacturing tooling. Experience with UEFI and numerous hardware stacks, including USB, storage and network stacks.
• Implemented Unified Flashing Platform (UFP) feature parity to existing client tools. UFP increased flashing speeds by up to 10X , reducing turnover time in both lab, manufacturing, and selfhost scenarios.
• Fully spec'd and implemented Surface Manufacturing Firmware Unlock into UFP flashing stack.
• Fully spec'd and implemented QC EDL/VIP device detection and disaster recovery framework into UFP.
• Implemented FFU ramboot solution in UFP which allows OEMs to leverage on-physical disk BSP drivers from rambooted environment, allowing them to efficiently and non-intrusively test final shipping configuration.
• Implemented and designed various aspects UEFI initiated Cloud Bare Metal Recovery solution (formally known as CSR, Connected System Recovery).
• Implementing next-gen Desktop manufacturing tooling.

positions.title: Software Developer, Globo app
positions.description:
• Created 3 soccer themed video games using Phaser game engine (Javascript based).
• Incorporated soccer themed video game into Globo app, which is an app released by GloboTV during the World Cup with more than 1 million installs, and that allows users to watch replays, view player statistics, participate in polls and mini games, and interact with other users, all in real time.
• Developed video game framework built on top of the Phaser game engine that allows developers to efficiently create, maintain, and integrate video games into the Globo app.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer, Xbox Console Group
positions.description:
• Created automation test suites for SmartGlass app.
• Added feature instrumentation to track end-to-end user scenarios.
• Implemented visualization tool for instrumentation data.

positions.title: Sofware Developer, FaceReel app
positions.description:
• Implemented alpha compositing algorithm using C++ to create smooth transitions between images.
• Developed algorithm using C++ that creates .mp4 videos using the VisionTools API.
• Added native code into the VisionTools API that supports interleaving of audio.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Comparative Media Studies with Computer Science

projects.title: Aquatic Evolver
projects.description: It's kill or be killed in ancient, primordial waters. Sure, all you have is one measly tentacle now, but the right skills, you can evolve to be so much more. Pick your battles carefully! Fight, flee, evolve!
